name: Little Tree | 200mg Live Resin Gummies | Grape
description:
10 Gummies | 20MG Each | Live Resin

Our Grape Live Resin Gummies feature a jammy, terpene-rich profile and 20MG of premium live resin per gummy. The result? A full-spectrum experience that soothes the body and lifts the mind.

With a lush grape finish and soft texture, this gummy is made for deep conversations and slow sunsets.

Whether you're resetting or reconnecting—this gummy brings intention to the moment.
